name: college-competition-coaching-team
description: A multi-agent coaching team for Chinese college innovation/startup and academic-tech competitions: topic planning, material prep, writing polish, review and defense rehearsal.

displayDescription.zh: 从选题、申报材料、文本打磨到模拟答辩全程陪练，内置真实获奖案例与各赛道评分标准，随问随练。
displayDescription.en: A coaching team that walks you from topic selection and application materials to polished drafts and mock defenses, with real award-winning cases and per-track scoring rubrics built in.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想参加中国国际大学生创新大赛（原互联网+），但还不知道做什么项目，请帮我做选题规划和备赛路径设计。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to join the China International College Students' Innovation Competition (formerly Internet+) but don't know what project to do yet — help me plan the topic and a preparation roadmap.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想参加中国国际大学生创新大赛（原互联网+），但还不知道做什么项目，请帮我做选题规划和备赛路径设计。
quickPrompts.en: I want to join the China International College Students' Innovation Competition (formerly Internet+) but don't know what project to do yet — help me plan the topic and a preparation roadmap.

quickPrompts.zh: 请按大赛评审标准，帮我搭好项目计划书的完整框架，并逐节说明评委最关注的得分点。
quickPrompts.en: Please build a complete framework for my project plan according to the competition's judging criteria, and explain the scoring points judges care about most, section by section.

quickPrompts.zh: 请模拟评委，针对我的项目连问 10 个高频答辩问题，逐题点评我的回答并给出改进建议。
quickPrompts.en: Play the role of a judge: ask me 10 high-frequency defense questions about my project one by one, critique each answer, and tell me how to improve.
